title: The specified completed reindexing squares, mates and normalization predicates
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d over a commutative ring A, retain the completed ring sheaves and canonical coefficient isomorphisms of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], the actual strict tower operations of [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations], and a chosen Cartesian square as in [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Define purReindexingTestSquare as the canonical composition of pro-etale base-change functors around its commuting scheme square. Specialize the ringed square to the completed coefficient sheaves and their canonical identifications. Define purReindexingModuleMate by the ordinary adjunction mate of its canonical module pullback square; define purReindexingTowerModuleMate by strict index whiskering; define purReindexingDerivedMate by the specified ambient exchange of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Define PurCompletedReindexingAt and PurCompletedReindexingSquare as the explicit conjunctions of the reindexing, completion, reduction and mate normalization equations. These are exactly the seven definitions formerly housed in the parent module, with all seven signatures unchanged and four bodies verbatim. The tower-mate body uses the generic purWhiskerCompositeMap wrapper around the same whiskering map to keep tensor data out of the kernel comparison; these predicates assert no mathematical result. Each predicate clause is factored into its own named proposition to share its fully typed expression. Unfolding those clauses yields the original conjunction verbatim.

proof_origin.place: Data relocation with generic tower whiskering wrapper and shared literal predicate clauses; all original public signatures and predicate meanings are retained.

mathlib_searches.query: For an isomorphism of schemes, completed coefficient module pullback agrees with section reindexing and preserves derived inverse limits, quotient augmentation and adjunction base change mates
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results give ordinary scheme module pullback and generic sheaf pullback constructions; none concerns the project completed pro-etale coefficient operations or their specified normalizations.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image of module sheaves under a site equivalence, preservation of derived inverse limit and compatibility of base change mates with derived functors
mathlib_searches.results: ExactFunctor derived descent APIs are available; no theorem identifies these published completed-ring operations and their specified normalization maps in one specialization.
General equivalence infrastructure does not state the completed coefficient section and derived-unit normalization equations.

Sheaf.PushforwardContinuous supplies the action-transport equivalence, and limit.post supplies the ordinary limit map. Neither states the comparison with the project tensor pullback, completed quotient augmentation or specified derived mates.
